title: Prompt Commons: Collective Prompting as Governance for Urban AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model recommendations on a contested-choice urban policy benchmark by classifying outputs as Left-leaning, Right-leaning, or Neutral/compromise, and tracking the decisiveness score across different prompting governance states.

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Intersectional bias (Age, Gender, Ethnicity, Disability, Sexual Orientation, Religion)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring subgroup satisfaction using a 7-point Likert scale gathered from community reviewers across six self-identified groups (seniors, women, ethnic minority, disability, LGBTQ+, religious minority) and calculating the dispersion (Gini coefficient) to assess outcome disparity.
